about: The standard scenes a probe plays, one timeline each (named <subject>_<scene>_timeline.json). Record from just before the cause to 1 s after.

fire_wall.do: hold the trigger for 1 s with the weapon in hand, aimed at a flat wall 5 m ahead (the probe puts one there if the level has none), the player standing still, the gun full

fire_zombie.do: fire at an enemy 8 m ahead until it dies (or 3 s), aimed at its chest

dry_fire.do: pull the trigger twice on an empty gun

reload.do: reload until the gun is loaded: a magazine, or a tube one round at a time; record to the last sound

hurt_front.do: the player takes one hit of 20 damage from straight ahead

hurt_left.do: the player takes one hit of 20 damage from the left

hurt_back.do: the player takes one hit of 20 damage from behind

blast_5.do: a hand grenade goes off 5 m ahead of the player (doing no harm, for the test)

blast_15.do: a hand grenade goes off 15 m ahead

blast_50.do: a hand grenade goes off 50 m ahead

walk.do: walk forward for 3 s on level ground
